live_refresh.limitation: Primary current repositories were observable, but general web search was unavailable during the material research cycle. No claim is promoted solely from unavailable web evidence.

main_progress_deltas: Qwen3.5 vision removes Qwen3-VL DeepStack paths and exposes distinct pre-merger and merged visual representation strata.

llama.cpp public mtmd-helper code can decode an image from an already-calculated embedding buffer, strengthening same-cycle MVC-to-semantic-decode reuse from theoretical to implementation-level feasible without a private decoder hook.

A four-lifetime visual-state split is proposed so raw multimodal embeddings are ephemeral, compact MVC descriptors are versioned persistent state, and llama.cpp media/slot state remains an optional implementation cache rather than semantic truth.
MobileCLIP2-S0 is elevated to a concrete mandatory lightweight counterbaseline; DINOv3 ViT-S/16 remains a dense-feature adversarial baseline.
Feature-level discrimination is revised from Qwen-vs-separate-encoder to projected-grid vs pre-merger-grid vs lightweight-independent-encoder under identical user-specific open-set fixtures.
